widgets.name: nexioPageSubtitle
widgets.ct:content: Verify the competition rules or load example records to explore Nexio locally.

widgets.name: competitionChecksView
widgets.t:noEntityMessage: Checks are not available. Start the local app and refresh this page.

widgets.name: competitionWidget94
widgets.ct:content: These checks use sample matches and do not change your clubs, members or invoices. After running them, select Refresh results to load the latest status.

widgets.name: competitionWidget95
widgets.ct:content: Passed means the rule behaved as expected. Failed means it needs investigation before relying on the schedule.

widgets.name: developmentSamplesIntro
widgets.ct:content: Generate examples for your local development app. Run this again after new features are added: missing examples are included and existing demo work is kept.

widgets.name: developmentSamplesContents
widgets.ct:content: 4 clubs · 1 federation · 60 disabled sample accounts · 12 teams · 2 leagues · 104 venue availability windows

widgets.name: developmentSamplesCrm
widgets.ct:content: Club administration: current, next, past and later planned seasons, seasonal fees, secretary and competition coordinator roles with permissions and staff, members, registrations, events, news and unpaid invoices.

widgets.name: developmentSamplesCompetition
widgets.ct:content: Competitions: open the [DEMO] federation and its Ready to schedule league. Allocate poules, generate fixtures, plan and publish. Each club’s third team can join the Open registration league.

widgets.name: developmentSamplesScope
widgets.ct:content: Records are marked [DEMO]. Only platform administrators can generate or remove them, and the server allows both actions only in the local Studio Pro development runtime.

widgets.name: developmentSamplesInvoices
widgets.ct:content: Sample accounts cannot sign in. Email addresses are fictional; no email is sent and no payment is confirmed.

widgets.name: developmentSamplesRemoval
widgets.ct:content: Remove the sample set when you are done. This also removes new records linked to sample clubs, leagues and teams. Older records and unrelated accounts are preserved. If an older record was linked to a sample record, removal stops so you can unlink it first.

confirmationInfo.t:question: Remove generated sample records and new records linked to sample clubs, leagues and teams? Older records and unrelated accounts are preserved. Your changes within the sample set will be lost.

widgets.name: competitionWidget8
widgets.ct:content: An available match can be planned

widgets.name: competitionWidget9
widgets.ct:content: Allows a match when the host venue is open and no booking conflicts exist.

widgets.name: competitionWidget16
widgets.ct:content: Blocks a match when the chosen availability window is inactive.

widgets.name: competitionWidget23
widgets.ct:content: Blocks a slot belonging to a different club.

widgets.name: competitionWidget30
widgets.ct:content: Blocks a match that starts before the venue opens.

widgets.name: competitionWidget37
widgets.ct:content: Blocks a match that would finish after the venue closes.

widgets.name: competitionWidget44
widgets.ct:content: Allows two separate matches together when both club and venue limits permit it.

widgets.name: competitionWidget51
widgets.ct:content: Allows one match to begin exactly when another ends.

widgets.name: competitionWidget57
widgets.ct:content: One match per team per day

widgets.name: competitionWidget58
widgets.ct:content: Blocks a second match for the same team on the same competition day.

widgets.name: competitionWidget65
widgets.ct:content: Blocks another home match when the club has reached its daily hosting limit.

widgets.name: competitionWidget72
widgets.ct:content: Blocks overlapping home matches when the club’s concurrent limit is reached.

widgets.name: competitionWidget79
widgets.ct:content: Blocks another overlapping match when all venue capacity is used.

widgets.name: competitionWidget85
widgets.ct:content: A player cannot play twice that day

widgets.name: competitionWidget86
widgets.ct:content: Blocks a match if a player already plays for another team on the same day.

widgets.name: competitionWidget96
widgets.ct:content: Still to verify with real user roles

widgets.name: competitionWidget97
widgets.ct:content: These are separate integration scenarios. They are not included in the twelve automated scheduling checks.

widgets.name: competitionWidget99
widgets.ct:content: Check registration windows, eligible players, affiliation dates, duplicates and roster locking.

widgets.name: competitionWidget101
widgets.ct:content: Check that staff can manage only their assigned clubs or federations and only the actions their role allows.

widgets.name: competitionWidget103
widgets.ct:content: Check poule capacity, same-club separation, explicit overrides and the correct fixture count.

widgets.name: competitionWidget105
widgets.ct:content: Check that invalid schedules cannot be published, both clubs must approve changes, and federation overrides are recorded.
